svg.title: Pipeline flow
svg.desc: Read left to right in three numbered sections. Source PDF preparation, direct DeepSeek extraction, DeepSeek source fidelity and MiMo Flash identity assembly precede provisional claim grouping. MiMo Flash plans literature searches. Independent Europe PMC and OpenAlex discovery and attached citation resolution merge before BGE, BM25 and MedCPT metadata ranking. Fetch exact source text, index identified sentences and rerank chunks with BGE and MedCPT. For a claim group, the selected paper packets fan out into repeated DeepSeek Flash per-paper calls. Each returns independent claim verdicts and paper-bound proof. Validated findings converge into one MiMo v2.6 Pro synthesis per group. Optional DeBERTa NLI adds diagnostics, not votes. Evidence balance and graph admission remain per claim. Displayed paper lanes are illustrative, not a fixed three-paper budget. Current implemented trust_graph mode, 28 October 2026. Based on backend/pipelines/trust.py, backend/stages/trust_graph/judgement.py, backend/stages/trust_graph/ledger.py, backend/stages/evidence_ranking/articles.py, backend/stages/evidence_ranking/passages.py and backend/config/settings.py. Font glyphs are vector outlines for portable rendering.

g.aria-label: Current trust-graph pipeline · end-to-end evidence and model flow
GROUND THE CLAIMS IN THE PDF
Per-claim verdicts · batches of 3 by default
each claim keeps its own evidence, conditions and decision
RAG selection finds evidence; ranking is not a scientific verdict
SQLite · exact text · sentence IDs · reusable embeddings
Up to 8 discovered papers / claim by default, plus all usable resolved source citations
JUDGE EACH PAPER, THEN SYNTHESIZE THE GROUP
A separate verdict and proof for every claim
Diagnostic scores only · no trust vote
